title: Horizon Sprint
core_verb: Drive a car along a marked point-to-point road course toward the finish line.
fantasy: A festival road race across open countryside, reduced to a greyboxed highway with barriers and checkpoints.
fail_state: The race timer reaches zero before the car crosses the finish line, or the car's health reaches zero from collisions.
win_state: Cross the finish line before the race timer reaches zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: Barrier or obstacle that damages the car on collision.
Road pickup that temporarily increases the car's acceleration and maximum speed.
Goal trigger at the end of the course; crossing it before time expires wins the race.

notes: Forza Horizon 5's open-world and multiplayer racing are reduced to one single-player point-to-point sprint against a countdown timer, with no AI opponents or free-roam objectives.

scene.description: A sunlit countryside highway stretching to the horizon, worn asphalt with painted lane markings. Road barriers narrow the racing line, speed boost pickups sit along it, and a finish line gate closes the run. Low hedgerows, fence posts, hay bales and parked tractors fill the margins; moderate clutter, with room to pick a line.
